_doc: How each Uranium item the engine lacks is generated (item_converter). Operator rulings, 2026-10-19 (reference/intermission_a1_a2.md section 3, 'S2 items rulings').
Keys are Uranium internal names. An item in Essentials pocket 8 with no entry here is a 'key' item; every other missing item must be listed, or generation fails loud.

kind: key = key item with no use; inert = bag item with no use; held = holdable item with no hold effect; berry = clone of `analog` in every berry table; heal = clone of `analog` with a composed HP-heal/status-cure effect; blocked = not generated (a script that grants it fails loud at conversion).
Behaviour follows Uranium's scripts, not its descriptions: items Uranium's battle code never checks are generated without effects.
